$comment: The workstation's MinIO (docker-compose.dev.yml), mirroring the hosts' layout (DEPLOYMENT.md §2): one public media bucket and one private masters bucket serve both sites. The app's media key writes only the media bucket; its masters key reads every master, writes captures under masters/ and deletes nothing. The media bucket is the dev container's test-media, which docker-compose.dev.yml already makes and .env.example names, until OPS renames it (TASKS.md 2.4's report). Applied by `pnpm --filter @engine/media storage:policies`.

mastersCors.$comment: The admin origin (its SITE_URL) may send the presigned PUT of a master (DEPLOYMENT.md §2). A worktree's port is allocated per phase and lane, so locally any loopback port is admitted, and nothing else. MinIO's community edition implements no per-bucket CORS (PutBucketCors: NotImplemented; it answers CORS from its server-wide api cors_allow_origin, `*` by default), so on the dev container apply warns and goes on; a host's plan says nothing here, and fails instead.
